mapper.select: SELECT SUM(om.current_output) AS totalOutput, IFNULL((SUM(CASE WHEN od.is_scrap = '0' THEN od.total_quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(om.current_output)) * 100, 0) AS yieldRate, IFNULL((SUM(CASE WHEN od.is_scrap = '1' THEN od.total_quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(om.current_output)) * 100, 0) AS scrapRate, AVG(om.hot_charging_rate) AS hotChargingRate, AVG(om.inventory_rate) AS inventoryRate FROM order_main om JOIN order_detail od ON om.order_code = om.order_code and od.del_flag='0' WHERE om.del_flag='0' and om.company_id= #{companyId} and om.order_year = #{orderYear} and om.order_month = #{orderMonth}

SELECT -- 将日期格式化为 YYYY-MM-DD 形式，作为横坐标数据 DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%d') AS orderDate, -- 统计每个日期的实际生产数量 SUM(current_output) AS actualProduction, -- 统计每个日期的计划生产数量 SUM(planned_production) AS plannedProduction FROM order_main WHERE company_id= #{companyId} -- 筛选指定年份的订单数据 AND order_year = #{orderYear} -- 筛选指定月份的订单数据 AND order_month = #{orderMonth} -- 只查询未删除的订单数据 AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY -- 按日期分组 DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY -- 按日期升序排序 DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.sql: select om.id as id, om.company_id as companyId, om.order_code as orderCode, om.order_year as orderYear, om.order_month as orderMonth, om.planned_production as plannedProduction, om.current_output as currentOutput, om.steel_spec as steelSpec, om.yield_rate as yieldRate, om.hot_charging_rate as hotChargingRate, om.scrap_rate as scrapRate, om.inventory_rate as inventoryRate, om.create_time as createTime, om.remark as remark, d.dict_label as orderStatus, om.est_comp_time as estCompTime from order_main om left JOIN sys_dict_data d ON om.order_status = d.dict_value
mapper.select: where d.dict_type = 'order_status' and om.del_flag='0' and om.order_code = #{orderCode}

SELECT order_month AS orderDate, SUM(current_output) AS actualProduction, SUM(planned_production) AS plannedProduction FROM order_main WHERE company_id= #{companyId} -- 筛选指定年份的订单数据 AND order_year = #{orderYear} -- 只查询未删除的订单数据 AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY -- 按日期分组 order_month ORDER BY -- 按日期升序排序 order_month
